name: Design stage of estimate basis
description: Design stage on which the estimate is based (e.g. concept, schematic, detailed design, IFC/tender, as-built). Drives expected quantity completeness and the contingency/risk posture.
notes: Record stage per project; linked to design-maturity confidence in family L.

name: Drawing register and revision baseline
description: Identifies the drawing set, issue date and revision letters on which quantities and scope were taken. Later revisions must be assessed through revision-difference review.
notes: List drawing numbers and revisions or reference the transmittal.

name: Specification and BOQ revision baseline
description: Specification volumes, addenda and tender BOQ revisions used. Conflicts between specification and drawings must be resolved and recorded.
notes: Include addenda and clarifications issued during tender.

name: Date of design information cut-off
description: Date after which later design information or addenda were not incorporated into the estimate.
notes: Estimate validity depends on this date.

name: Scope inclusions statement
description: Explicit description of what is included in the estimate, by package or cost-code division, to avoid gaps against client requirements.
notes: Refer to scope matrix where available.

name: Scope exclusions statement
description: Explicit description of items excluded from the estimate (e.g. client-supplied items, off-site infrastructure, authority connection fees, FF&E, IT equipment).
notes: Exclusions must be carried into the tender qualifications.

name: Scope boundary - client-supplied or free-issue items
description: Items supplied by client or other parties and issued free to the contractor; cost excludes supply but may include handling, storage and installation.
notes: Confirm responsibility for damage, storage and insurance of free-issue items.

name: Scope boundary - enabling and early works
description: Whether enabling works, site clearance, demolition, soil remediation or early works packages are within the estimate scope.
notes: Select included / excluded / by others per project.

name: Scope boundary - off-site and utility authority works
description: Whether off-site infrastructure and utility-authority connection works (power, water, sewer, telecom) are in or out of scope, and who pays authority connection charges.
notes: Interfaces with authority works are a common source of omissions.

name: Provisional sums and prime-cost sums basis
description: How provisional and prime-cost sums are treated: values stated by client, estimator allowance, or excluded; and whether margin/attendance applies.
notes: Values must come from tender documents; do not invent.

name: Applicable codes and standards
description: Governing codes and standards (e.g. Saudi Building Code SBC parts, SASO, SEC requirements, Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Aramco/ project standards, referenced international standards).
notes: List edition years where specified; verify current editions.

name: Authority requirements affecting scope
description: Requirements by municipality (Balady/Amanah), Civil Defense, Saudi Electricity Company, National Water Company and other authorities that add scope, fees or testing.
notes: Capture approvals required before works start.

name: Local content and national-content obligations
description: Contractual or tender requirements for local content, Saudization, or national-product preference that may influence material sourcing and labour mix.
notes: Confirm with client conditions and current regulations; do not assume.

name: Design responsibility allocation
description: Whether design is by the client (build-only), by the contractor (design-and-build), or partly delegated (e.g. specialist sub-systems, shop drawings, temporary works design).
notes: Design-and-build requires design fee and risk allowances to be considered.

name: Contractor-designed portions and design fees
description: Elements designed by the contractor or subcontractors and how their design fees and professional indemnity cover are priced.
notes: Link to L.01 Design and engineering allowances.

name: Performance requirements and guarantees
description: Specified performance criteria (e.g. energy, acoustics, water-tightness, capacity, availability) that carry guarantee or testing consequences.
notes: Identify which require performance bonds, testing or warranties.

name: Interface with other trades and packages
description: Responsibility for builder's work in connection, holes, sleeves, bases, fire stopping, painting of services and making good between trades.
notes: Use interface matrix; unresolved items to be logged as open assumptions.

name: Interface with client direct contractors
description: Works carried out concurrently by client's other contractors and how access, coordination and delays are priced.
notes: Include attendance and coordination obligations.

name: Value engineering and alternatives accepted
description: Whether the estimate includes accepted value-engineering proposals or approved alternatives to the specified design.
notes: Alternatives need documented client/consultant approval.

name: Phasing and handover sequence
description: Planned phases, sectional completion and handover sequence assumed in the estimate.
notes: Affects duration, access and indirect costs.

name: Construction duration basis
description: Contract or planned construction period assumed for the estimate (start date, completion date, milestones); drives duration-dependent indirects.
notes: Value comes from programme or tender documents.

name: Temporary works design responsibility
description: Who designs and certifies temporary works, shoring, scaffolding and falsework, and whether independent checking is priced.
notes: Link to shoring and scaffolding rates.

name: Concrete and structural design basis
description: Assumed concrete grades, exposure classes, durability and cover requirements affecting cost (e.g. sulphate-resisting cement, high chloride exposure).
notes: Taken from structural specification; do not assume.

name: MEP design basis and system selection
description: Assumed system types and capacity basis for HVAC, plumbing, fire and electrical where design is incomplete.
notes: Flag as design allowance when system is not selected.

name: Specified manufacturers and approved brands
description: Whether materials and equipment are restricted to named manufacturers or approved-vendor lists.
notes: Restricts competitive pricing; affects supplier quote coverage.

name: Sustainability and green-building requirements
description: Mandatory rating or sustainability requirements (e.g. Mostadam, LEED, energy efficiency) that add cost or documentation.
notes: Include certification fees where required.

name: Measurement basis
description: Measurement rules used to derive quantities (e.g. SMM-based, CESMM, project-specific method of measurement, first-principles take-off). Determines inclusions in unit rates.
notes: State rules and any deviations; rates must match the measurement basis.

name: Quantity source
description: Origin of quantities: client BOQ, own take-off, imported take-off from BIM/CAD, subcontractor quantities, or allowances.
notes: Record per package where mixed.

name: Quantity status and completeness
description: Whether quantities are firm, provisional, or approximate; completeness assessment for each division.
notes: Feeds quantity-completeness confidence in family L.

name: Quantity rounding for display and reporting
description: Decimal places to which computed resource quantities are rounded for display/reporting only. Underlying calculations retain full precision to avoid compounding rounding differences.
notes: Methodological setting; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Measured-quantity rounding convention
description: Rounding convention for measured BOQ quantities (e.g. nearest whole unit, one decimal) where it differs from the display rounding.
notes: Document where client BOQ requires specific rounding.

name: Unit conversion basis
description: Conversion factors used between measurement units (e.g. weight-to-length for reinforcement and pipe, area-to-volume for thickness) and their sources.
notes: Use unit table where possible; source other factors from supplier datasheets.

name: Reinforcement density basis
description: Whether reinforcement is measured from bar schedules, estimated as kg per m3 of concrete, or taken from an allowance.
notes: Density ratios are project/design-specific; do not apply generic ratios without approval.

name: Bar weight and steel section weight source
description: Source for unit weights of reinforcement bars and structural sections (nominal standard weights vs. supplier actual).
notes: Confirm tolerance treatment.

name: Deduction of openings convention
description: Minimum opening size below which openings are not deducted from wall, floor or finish areas, per the measurement method.
notes: Value defined by the measurement method; record explicitly.

name: Deduction of voids, columns and ducts in slab quantities
description: Treatment of voids, service penetrations and embedded items when measuring concrete, screed and finishes.
notes: State threshold sizes.

name: Wall and floor finishes measurement - net or gross
description: Whether finishes are measured net of skirting, openings and fittings, and how returns, reveals and edges are measured.

name: Excavation measurement basis
description: Basis for excavation volumes: net to formation lines, with working space, side slopes or bulking allowances measured separately.
notes: Do not double-count working space allowances with excavation support.

name: Bulking and shrinkage factors for earthworks
description: Volume change factors between bank, loose and compacted states for soil and rock.
notes: Obtain from geotechnical report; value is soil-specific.

name: Imported quantity validation rules
description: Checks applied to imported quantities (unit consistency, duplicates, missing items, zero or negative values, outliers against benchmark ranges) before use.
notes: Log failures; do not silently correct imported quantities.

name: Imported quantity unit mapping
description: Mapping from source unit text to system unit codes, including resolution of ambiguous units.
notes: Ambiguous synonyms must be resolved by an estimator.

name: Quantity revision difference handling
description: How quantity changes between drawing revisions are identified, reported and priced (additions, omissions, re-measurement).
notes: Retain previous revision for comparison.

name: Quantity tolerance thresholds for review
description: Percentage or absolute change between revisions or against cross-checks that triggers mandatory estimator review.
notes: Threshold to be set by company; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Quantity cross-check method
description: Independent checks of quantities, such as ratios (steel per m3, finish area per GFA) against benchmark data.
notes: Benchmark sources must be recorded.

name: Gross floor area and area definitions
description: Definitions of gross floor area, net lettable area and built-up area used for rates per area and benchmarking.
notes: State the standard (e.g. client definition).

name: Provisional quantity allowance basis
description: Basis for any quantity allowance added to cover incomplete design (unmeasured items, minor work).
notes: Allowance percentage must be project-specific and approved; avoid overlap with contingency.

name: Daywork and remeasurement items
description: Treatment of daywork and remeasurable items in the estimate, including provisional quantities.
notes: Confirm the contract form.

name: Lump-sum and allowance item breakdown
description: Where quantities are given as lump sums, whether an internal breakdown is made and on what basis.
notes: Unpriced breakdown must be flagged as low confidence.

name: Unit of measure for composite assemblies
description: Unit to which assembly rates apply (e.g. per m2 of facade, per room) and the included components.
notes: Check assembly contents against the BOQ description.

name: Material consumption factor basis
description: Source and definition of consumption factors (net quantity per unit of work) and whether they include waste.
notes: Never apply together with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage inclusion convention
description: Whether wastage is added as a separate allowance or is embedded in consumption factors or unit rates, to prevent double counting.
notes: Never apply a separate wastage % on top of a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Concrete
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of concrete (spillage, over-excavation overbreak, pump line loss, test cubes and returned loads). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Reinforcement steel
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of reinforcement steel (cutting off-cuts, lap lengths, bending losses and rejected bars). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Blocks and masonry units
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of blocks and masonry units (breakage, cutting, transport damage and mortar loss). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Tiles and stone
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of tiles and stone (cutting, breakage, pattern matching and shade-batch losses). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Paint and coatings
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of paint and coatings (roller/brush absorption, spillage, surface porosity and tinted-batch remnants). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Plaster, render and screed
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of plaster, render and screed (dropping, rebound and over-thickness). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Plasterboard and drywall
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of plasterboard and drywall (cutting, damage and offcuts). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Pipe (metallic and plastic)
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of pipe (metallic and plastic) (cutting off-cuts, fittings and weld losses). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Duct sheet metal and fabricated duct
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of duct sheet metal and fabricated duct (nesting losses, off-cuts and fabrication rejects). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Cable
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of cable (drum remnants, pulling allowances and terminations). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Insulation
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of insulation (cutting, compression and adhesive/cladding losses). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Asphalt and bituminous materials
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of asphalt and bituminous materials (truck remnants, edge trimming, laydown losses and rejected loads). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Fill, sub-base and aggregates
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of fill, sub-base and aggregates (spillage, compaction loss, trimming and stockpile degradation). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Structural steel
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of structural steel (cutting, fabrication off-cuts and bolt/weld consumables). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Glass and glazing
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of glass and glazing (breakage, cutting and handling damage). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - Formwork materials
description: Allowance for material lost in handling and installation of formwork materials (number of reuses, damage and consumables). Applied to net measured quantity; value is material-, supplier- and site-specific.
notes: No default; must be approved by Estimator before use. Do not apply with a consumption factor that already includes waste.

name: Wastage - general consumables and fixings
description: Allowance for small consumables (nails, ties, spacers, fixings, sealant) where not priced in the item rate.
notes: Check whether the rate already includes consumables.

name: Reuse cycles for formwork and temporary materials
description: Assumed number of reuses of formwork, scaffolding and temporary materials before replacement.
notes: Project-specific; do not use generic values without approval.

name: Cutting losses and standard lengths
description: Treatment of cutting waste where materials are supplied in standard lengths or sheet sizes (rebar 12 m, pipe lengths, boards, panels).
notes: Cutting plan may reduce waste; record assumption.

name: Packaging and returnable packaging
description: Allowance for packaging, pallets, drums, reels and deposits that are not returned or are chargeable.
notes: Record deposit refund assumptions.

name: Minimum order quantities
description: Supplier minimum order quantities and the resulting surplus where project demand is below the minimum.
notes: Surplus cost applies only if not reusable elsewhere.

name: Procurement allowance for early or bulk buying
description: Allowance or discount basis for bulk or early purchase of materials versus per-delivery pricing.
notes: Evidence required (quotation); do not assume discounts.

name: Approved alternative materials
description: Whether alternatives to the specified material are accepted and how price differences are treated.
notes: Requires documented approval by consultant/client.

name: Material price validity period
description: Quoted validity period of supplier prices and the assumption on price firmness beyond that date.
notes: Compare with expected procurement date.

name: Material supply - local vs imported basis
description: Assumed sourcing (local stock, local manufacture, import) per material category, affecting lead time, logistics and customs.
notes: Link to freight and customs assumptions (F).

name: Free-issue or client-supplied materials
description: Materials supplied by the client and the contractor's responsibility for handling, storage and wastage.

name: Material testing and sampling losses
description: Material consumed in samples, mock-ups and destructive testing (e.g. test cubes, mock-up panels).
notes: Include mock-up requirement where specified.

name: Surplus and left-over material treatment
description: Treatment of surplus material at completion (credited, retained, disposed).

name: Material rate basis - delivered or ex-works
description: Whether material rates are delivered to site, ex-works, or ex-warehouse, to avoid double counting freight.
notes: Check freight rows in family F.

name: Material specification grade assumption
description: Assumed grade, class or standard (e.g. concrete strength, steel grade, pipe class) for rates where the specification is not explicit.
notes: Flag as assumption in tender qualifications.

name: Material shelf life and storage loss
description: Allowance for materials with limited shelf life or heat sensitivity (cement, paint, adhesives, sealants) in KSA conditions.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Temporary materials supplied by subcontractors
description: Whether subcontractor rates include their own temporary materials and consumables.

name: Paid hours per shift
description: Paid hours per shift (including breaks as paid) used to convert shift-based labour rates to hourly rates.
notes: No default; set per project from labour agreements and policy. Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productive hours per shift
description: Productive working hours per shift after deducting breaks, travel, prayer times, briefings and idle time.
notes: No default; must be less than or equal to paid hours per shift; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Working days per week
description: Working days per week assumed on site for labour, plant and programme calculations.
notes: No default; set per project calendar.

name: Working days per month
description: Average working days per month assumed for converting monthly rates and durations.
notes: No default; must be consistent with working days per week and public holidays.

name: Working hours per day
description: Normal working hours per day on site used for calendar and rate conversions.
notes: No default; set per project from labour regulations and contract.

name: Working calendar and public holidays
description: Project calendar including weekends, national and religious holidays, and Ramadan and Eid adjustments.
notes: Reference calendar year; verify dates, which move annually.

name: Ramadan working hours adjustment
description: Reduced working hours or shifted shifts during Ramadan and the effect on productivity.
notes: Effect to be assessed per project; no default value.

name: Summer working-hour restrictions
description: Midday outdoor work restrictions in hot months and impact on shift pattern and output.
notes: Verify current regulations and enforcement; value is project-specific.

name: Overtime policy
description: Whether overtime is planned, how much, and the premium basis.
notes: Premium rates come from labour regulations/company policy.

name: Overtime premium rate
description: Premium multiplier or percentage applied to overtime hours.
notes: Source from labour law/company policy; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Night shift allowance
description: Premium or allowance for night shifts.
notes: Company-specific; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Crew composition basis
description: Source for crew composition (foreman, skilled, semi-skilled, general labour, operators) per activity.
notes: Use approved crew library; record exceptions.

name: Skill category mapping
description: Mapping of work activities to labour skill categories and trade classifications.
notes: Align to labour rate table categories.

name: Labour rate basis - direct vs subcontract
description: Whether labour is self-performed, supplied by manpower agency, or included in subcontractor rate.
notes: Avoids double counting of indirect labour costs.

name: Labour on-cost components
description: Components included in labour cost (basic wage, allowances, housing, transport, iqama, visa, medical, end-of-service, insurance).
notes: Check against the indirect cost rows to avoid duplication.

name: Labour productivity - general placeholder
description: General output per labour hour or crew-shift where trade-specific data are not available.
notes: No default; productivity is crew-, site- and project-specific.

name: Productivity placeholder - earthworks and excavation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for earthworks and excavation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - concrete placing and finishing
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for concrete placing and finishing. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - formwork erection and striking
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for formwork erection and striking. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - reinforcement fixing
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for reinforcement fixing. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - structural steel erection
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for structural steel erection. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - blockwork laying
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for blockwork laying. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - plastering and screeding
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for plastering and screeding. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - tiling and stone fixing
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for tiling and stone fixing. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - painting
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for painting. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - partition and drywall installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for partition and drywall installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - doors, windows and glazing installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for doors, windows and glazing installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - ductwork installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for ductwork installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - chilled-water and process piping installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for chilled-water and process piping installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - plumbing pipework installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for plumbing pipework installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - sprinkler pipework installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for sprinkler pipework installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - cable tray and conduit installation
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for cable tray and conduit installation. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - wiring and final circuits
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for wiring and final circuits. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - paving and road-base works
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for paving and road-base works. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity placeholder - trench and pipe-laying works
description: Placeholder for output per labour hour or per crew-shift for trench and pipe-laying works. Not populated; to be filled from company productivity records or approved library.
notes: No default; productivity varies by site conditions; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Productivity adjustment for height and access
description: Reduction in output for work at height, confined space or restricted access.
notes: Project-specific; evidence needed. Avoid double counting with location factors (G).

name: Productivity adjustment for heat and weather
description: Reduction in output due to ambient temperature, humidity, dust or sand storms.
notes: Estimator judgement; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Learning curve and repetition factor
description: Allowance for improved productivity through repetition on repetitive work (typical floors, units).
notes: Only with evidence.

name: Standby and non-productive time
description: Allowance for waiting, permit delays, inspections and non-productive time not included in the productivity rate.
notes: Avoid double counting with productive-hours assumption.

name: Supervision ratio
description: Number of workers per foreman/supervisor assumed for direct supervision included in crews.
notes: Check not duplicated in site supervision indirects (H).

name: Labour mobilisation lead time
description: Time required to recruit, visa and mobilise labour for the project.
notes: Project/labour market dependent; no default.

name: Labour availability constraint
description: Whether skilled labour availability limits the programme or requires premium pay.

name: Labour attrition and absenteeism allowance
description: Allowance for sickness, leave, absenteeism and turnover.
notes: Check whether embedded in labour rate.

name: Annual leave and end-of-service provision
description: Basis for provision of leave and end-of-service costs in labour rates.
notes: Source from labour law and company policy.

name: Shift pattern and rotation
description: Planned shift pattern (single, double, continuous) and how it is priced.

name: Plant hire duration
description: Assumed hire duration for each plant item, from programme or activity duration.
notes: Derive from programme; avoid arbitrary rounding up.

name: Plant hire basis
description: Basis for hire charges: dry hire, wet hire (with operator and fuel), owned-plant internal rate, or subcontract.
notes: Avoid double counting operators and fuel under wet hire.

name: Plant utilisation percentage
description: Share of paid or hired plant time that is productive. Used to convert plant outputs and costs per productive hour.
notes: No default; plant-, activity- and site-specific. Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Plant hire minimum charge period
description: Minimum charge periods and idle-time charges imposed by plant suppliers.
notes: Source from quotes.

name: Fuel supply and fuel price basis
description: Who supplies fuel and the fuel price source used for plant running costs.
notes: Fuel price is regulated and may change; verify date.

name: Fuel consumption per plant hour
description: Fuel consumption assumptions per plant item.
notes: From manufacturer data or records; no default.

name: Operator inclusion and operator basis
description: Whether plant rates include operators, signalmen and banksmen, and their hours.
notes: Check against labour crews.

name: Operator certification requirements
description: Operator licences/certificates required (crane operators, riggers), and inspection requirements.
notes: Include third-party inspection costs.

name: Plant maintenance and repair allowance
description: Allowance for maintenance, tyres, wear parts and breakdown downtime on owned plant.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Plant mobilisation and demobilisation
description: Costs and routes for mobilising plant, including low-loaders, escorts and permits.
notes: Link to logistics assumptions (F).

name: Plant standby and idle rates
description: Rates and conditions for standby plant during weather, delays or access restrictions.

name: Crane selection and lifting basis
description: Crane types, capacities and lifting arrangements assumed (tower, mobile), with hire periods.
notes: Lift plan needed; do not assume capacities.

name: Plant breakdown and replacement allowance
description: Allowance for breakdown replacement and spare plant.

name: Small tools and consumables allowance
description: Basis for small tools, hand tools and minor equipment either included in labour rates or separately allowed.
notes: Avoid double counting with labour on-cost.

name: Plant ownership versus hire decision
description: Basis for treating plant as owned (depreciation, internal rate) or hired.

name: Plant insurance and registration
description: Insurance, registration and periodic inspection of plant.

name: Concrete pump and batching plant arrangement
description: Assumed concrete supply method: ready-mix, site batching, pump type.
notes: Affects delivery distance and wastage assumptions.

name: Plant transport on site and fuelling logistics
description: Internal movements, refuelling and storage of plant on site.

name: Temporary hoists and access equipment
description: Hoists, MEWPs and temporary access equipment hire assumptions.

name: Plant operating conditions derating
description: Derating of plant output due to heat, dust and altitude.
notes: Manufacturer recommendation required.

name: Delivery distance and haul route
description: Distance and routing from supplier or port to site, used for freight and haulage calculations.
notes: Project-specific.

name: Freight cost basis
description: Freight pricing basis: per tonne, per trip, per container, or included in supplier delivered price.
notes: Avoid double counting with delivered-price rates.

name: Import Incoterms and risk transfer
description: Incoterms assumed (EXW, FOB, CIF, DAP, DDP) determining freight, insurance and customs responsibility.
notes: Select per supplier quote.

name: Customs duty basis
description: Customs duty classification and treatment for imported materials/equipment (including any exemptions).
notes: Verify with customs tariff classification and current regulations; do not assume.

name: Customs clearance and port charges
description: Clearance agent fees, port handling, demurrage and terminal charges.
notes: Quote-based; no default.

name: Import conformity and certification charges
description: Product-conformity certification and inspection requirements for imported goods (e.g. SASO / SABER).
notes: Verify current requirements.

name: Marine and cargo insurance
description: Cargo insurance on imported or transported goods.

name: Unloading and handling method
description: How goods are unloaded and moved to point of use (crane, forklift, manual), and who provides it.
notes: Avoid duplication with plant and labour rows.

name: Handling losses and breakage in transit
description: Allowance for transit damage not covered by wastage.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: On-site storage and laydown
description: Storage arrangements (open, covered, air-conditioned) and rental of off-site yards.
notes: Heat-sensitive materials may need special storage.

name: Delivery restrictions - truck movement hours
description: Site and city restrictions on heavy truck movements (time windows, route bans).
notes: Check municipality rules.

name: Lead time and delivery schedule
description: Procurement lead times and delivery batches aligned with programme.
notes: Supplier-specific.

name: Long-lead items and expediting
description: Long-lead equipment and costs for expediting, factory inspection or air freight.

name: Oversize and abnormal load transport
description: Special transport permits and escorts for oversize loads (transformers, chillers, precast).

name: Delivery to height or restricted locations
description: Additional handling to deliver material to upper floors, basements or restricted areas.
notes: Avoid double counting with productivity adjustments.

name: Fuel surcharge and freight rate validity
description: Fuel surcharge treatment and quoted-rate validity for freight.

name: Reverse logistics and waste disposal
description: Transport of surplus, packaging and construction waste to approved disposal sites, including tipping fees.
notes: Check approved landfill or recycling facility and fees.

name: Currency of freight quotations
description: Currency of freight quotations and conversion basis.

name: Local procurement from nearest city
description: Whether local suppliers in the project city are used or materials are delivered from major hubs.

name: Project region
description: Region/city of the project used to select location factors and regional rates.
notes: Select from the regions table; do not use unlisted regions.

name: Regional cost adjustment basis
description: Basis for adjusting rates for location (index, supplier quotes, or none).
notes: Source required; no default.

name: Remote site access
description: Remoteness classification and effect on labour, accommodation, and logistics.
notes: Describe road, camp and distance.

name: Site access conditions
description: Road access, gate restrictions, clearance heights and turning space.

name: Working at height
description: Typical height of works and requirements for access equipment and fall protection.

name: Site congestion and limited laydown
description: Constraint from tight urban site, limited laydown, adjacent buildings.
notes: Affects productivity and logistics; avoid duplication.

name: Occupied facility or live operation
description: Works within an occupied or operating building (hospital, airport, plant, mall) with associated restrictions.
notes: Sets out hours, noise, dust, isolation and permit-to-work requirements.

name: Phased access and possession constraints
description: Limited possession windows or phased access to work areas.

name: Night work and out-of-hours working
description: Night or weekend working required by client or authorities (e.g. road works, airport).
notes: Premium and productivity effects must be priced.

name: Environmental restrictions
description: Dust, noise, vibration, emissions, waste and protected area restrictions.
notes: Link to HSE and environment plans.

name: Climatic conditions
description: Design temperature, humidity, wind, sand and flood considerations influencing work methods (hot weather concreting, cooling).
notes: Cost of hot-weather measures priced explicitly.

name: Ground conditions and groundwater
description: Soil type, rock, groundwater level, contamination as assumed from geotechnical reports.
notes: Absence of a geotechnical report must be recorded as a risk.

name: Dewatering requirement
description: Whether temporary dewatering is required and its duration.
notes: Link to ground conditions.

name: Existing services and utilities on site
description: Known and unknown underground services requiring locating, diversion or protection.

name: Archaeological, security or military restricted zones
description: Restrictions on access, photography, and personnel in sensitive zones.
notes: Include security clearance lead times.

name: Security clearance and site access permits
description: Permits and background checks needed for personnel and vehicles.
notes: Cost and time to be allowed in labour mobilisation.

name: Proximity to labour sources and accommodation
description: Distance between site and accommodation or labour pools affecting daily transport time.

name: Traffic management requirements
description: Road closure, diversion and traffic control needed for site works.

name: Seasonal weather windows
description: Seasons when works cannot be performed efficiently (e.g. rainy periods, extreme summer).

name: Local authority working-hour restrictions
description: Municipal or authority noise/working-hour limits in the area.

name: Site topography and level changes
description: Site slopes or level changes affecting earthworks, access and logistics.

name: Adjacent structures and protection requirements
description: Protection of neighbouring buildings or infrastructure, condition surveys and monitoring.

name: Indirect cost allocation method
description: How indirects are priced: time-related (duration-based), fixed, or percentage of direct cost.
notes: Do not apply percentage and time-related methods to the same cost item.

name: Project duration for indirects
description: Duration used for time-related indirects, which may differ from construction duration (mobilisation and close-out).
notes: Derived from programme.

name: Project management staff
description: Roles (project manager, deputy PM, planner, QS, document controller), time commitment and cost basis.
notes: Salaries are company-specific; no default.

name: Construction management staff
description: Roles (construction managers, engineers, planners, QA/QC, MEP managers), time commitment and cost basis.

name: Site supervision staff
description: Supervisors, foremen not included in crews, surveyors and inspection staff.
notes: Avoid duplicating supervision in direct crews.

name: Head office overhead allocation
description: Allocation of head office overhead to projects (percentage, fixed charge, or none).
notes: Distinguish overhead from profit.

name: Staff accommodation
description: Accommodation for site staff (rent, camp, hotel) and duration.
notes: Cost per person from quotes.

name: Labour camp
description: Labour camp (provision, rental, utilities, catering, maintenance).
notes: Obtain quotes.

name: Staff transport and vehicles
description: Staff vehicles, site transport and buses; basis for fuel, lease, insurance.

name: Labour transport
description: Transport of labour to and from site.

name: Site offices and welfare facilities
description: Offices, meeting rooms, toilets, prayer rooms, canteens; whether purchased, rented or built.

name: Client and consultant site facilities
description: Offices, vehicles, equipment and services to be provided for client or supervising consultant.
notes: Check contract requirements.

name: Site security and access control
description: Guarding, CCTV, fencing, lighting, gatehouse and badge control.

name: Temporary power
description: Temporary power supply (generators, grid connection, distribution) and consumption.
notes: Includes fuel for generators.

name: Temporary water and sanitation
description: Temporary water supply, tanker deliveries, wash facilities, sewage removal.

name: Temporary lighting
description: Temporary site lighting for safe night and internal working.

name: Telecommunications and IT
description: Site internet, phones, computers, software licences and project management systems.

name: HSE management and personnel
description: HSE personnel, training, inductions, PPE, signage, permits and emergency response.

name: Medical and first-aid facilities
description: Site clinic, medical staff, ambulance or first-aid provisions.

name: Environmental management
description: Dust suppression, waste management, spill kits, monitoring.

name: Scaffolding and temporary works - general
description: General scaffolding and temporary works not included in trade rates.

name: Hoarding and site protection
description: Site hoarding, protection of finished works and adjacent areas.

name: Cleaning and waste removal
description: Periodic cleaning, waste skips and final cleaning.

name: Survey and setting out
description: Surveyors, equipment and setting-out costs.

name: Quality assurance and quality control
description: QA/QC staff, laboratory sampling and testing of construction quality.

name: Project insurance - contractor's all-risk and third-party
description: CAR, third-party liability, workmen's compensation and other insurance.
notes: Premium rates by insurer quote; do not assume.

name: Insurance - professional indemnity
description: Professional indemnity insurance for design responsibilities.

name: Project administration and documentation
description: Document control, reporting, meetings, as-built drawing preparation and site administration.

name: Permits, licences and authority fees
description: Building permits, municipality fees, utility fees, trade licences.
notes: Check responsibility between client and contractor.

name: Mobilisation and demobilisation of site establishment
description: One-off mobilisation and demobilisation costs for site set-up and removal.

name: Duration-dependent expenses extension
description: Extension of time-related indirects if the programme is extended, and rate used.
notes: Link to escalation and delay risk.

name: Staff mobilisation and leave travel
description: Staff recruitment, visa, mobilisation, annual leave travel and replacement costs.

name: Indirects as percentage of direct cost
description: Percentage method, where used, and its base.
notes: Only if time-related method is not used; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Subcontractor attendance
description: Attendance provided to subcontractors (water, power, hoisting, storage, welfare).
notes: Avoid double counting with general site facilities.

name: Subcontractor preliminaries
description: Subcontractor preliminaries and supervision included within subcontract rates.

name: Commercial pricing method
description: Method for developing the sell price: markup on cost or target gross margin on price.
notes: No default. Markup on cost and gross margin are not interchangeable; the choice must be recorded and approved by Estimator.

name: Markup on cost percentage
description: Percentage added to total cost to produce sell price when using markup on cost.
notes: Company decision; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Gross margin on price percentage
description: Target gross margin as a percentage of sell price when using the margin method; sell price = cost / (1 - margin).
notes: Do not confuse with markup. Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Overhead recovery percentage
description: Percentage recovery of head-office overhead.
notes: Company decision; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Profit percentage
description: Profit allowance after overhead recovery.
notes: Company decision; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Contingency base
description: Cost base to which contingency applies (direct cost, direct plus indirect, total cost excluding provisional sums).
notes: Decide per project to avoid double counting.

name: Contingency percentage
description: Contingency allowance, derived from the risk assessment and design maturity.
notes: No default; Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Contingency and risk allowance relationship
description: Whether contingency and specific risk allowances are separately included or one covers the other.
notes: Avoid double counting.

name: Specific risk allowances
description: Itemised allowances for identified risks (ground conditions, interfaces, authority approvals).
notes: Link to risk register.

name: Escalation base
description: Cost base to which escalation applies (materials, labour, plant, subcontracts) and the base date.
notes: Define the rate base date.

name: Escalation index or source
description: Index or quote source used for escalation (published indices, supplier forecast).
notes: Source and date required.

name: Escalation percentage per annum
description: Annual escalation rate for the escalation base.
notes: No default; obtain from approved source.

name: Escalation period
description: Period from base date to mid-point of expenditure to which escalation applies.
notes: Derive from programme.

name: Currency exposure
description: Foreign-currency content of the estimate and treatment of exchange rate risk (e.g. SAR pegged to USD).
notes: Verify current exchange policy; record rate date.

name: Foreign exchange rates and date
description: Exchange rates used for converting quotations to SAR and their dates.
notes: Source and date required.

name: Estimate currency
description: Currency of the estimate and bid.

name: Monetary rounding
description: Decimal places for monetary amounts in calculations and outputs.
notes: Methodological setting; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Discounts and rebates
description: Supplier or subcontractor discounts (volume, early payment) allowed for in the estimate.
notes: Include only if confirmed in writing.

name: Retention percentage and release
description: Retention held by client, release dates, and the financing cost.
notes: From contract conditions.

name: Advance payment and recovery
description: Advance payment amount, security and recovery schedule.
notes: From contract.

name: Performance bond
description: Performance bond requirement, percentage, duration and cost.

name: Bid bond
description: Bid bond requirement and cost.

name: Advance payment guarantee
description: Guarantee required for advance payment and cost.

name: Warranty and defects liability period
description: Defects liability period, warranty obligations and provisions for cost.
notes: From contract.

name: Warranty cost provision
description: Provision for warranty and defects costs after completion.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Payment terms
description: Client payment terms (monthly certificates, milestone, days to payment).
notes: From contract.

name: Payment terms to suppliers and subcontractors
description: Terms offered by suppliers and subcontractors, relevant to cashflow.

name: Financing cost of cash flow
description: Cost of financing negative cash flow, interest rate and period.
notes: Company decision.

name: Liquidated damages
description: Liquidated damages rates, caps and probability allowances.
notes: From contract.

name: Tender validity period
description: Validity period of the tender/estimate.
notes: From tender documents.

name: Estimate base date
description: Date to which unit rates and prices relate.
notes: Used with rate age checks.

name: Contract form and risk allocation
description: Contract form (e.g. FIDIC, lump sum, remeasurement) and key risk-transfer clauses.

name: Price adjustment clauses
description: Whether the contract allows fluctuation or price adjustment for labour and materials.
notes: Affects escalation allowance.

name: Provisional sum margin
description: Markup or attendance on provisional and prime-cost sums.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Subcontractor markup and margin treatment
description: Whether subcontractor quotations are marked up by main contractor and how.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Alternative offers and options pricing
description: Treatment of optional or alternative prices.

name: Bid strategy adjustments
description: Commercial adjustments from management decision (unbalancing, discounts) applied after cost build-up.
notes: Must be recorded separately from cost.

name: Negotiated discount to client
description: Final discount offered to client.
notes: Management decision.

name: Default tax category
description: Default tax category code applied to cost lines where no specific category is set. The rate itself resides in the tax category table, not here.
notes: Methodological default; actual rate is held in the tax category table, and must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Tax basis of the estimate
description: Whether estimate prices are shown exclusive or inclusive of tax.
notes: Pre-tax cost should be the basis for sell price calculation.

name: Applicable tax categories
description: Tax categories (standard, zero-rated, exempt, out-of-scope) applicable to the project's supplies.
notes: Confirm with tax advisor.

name: Applicable tax rates
description: Rates for each tax category, kept in the tax category table with an effective date.
notes: Never hard-code rates in this register; verify current rate at estimate date.

name: Tax rate effective date
description: Effective date of the tax rates applied.
notes: Rates can change by decree; always verify the rate for the invoicing date.

name: Date-sensitive tax rate verification
description: Confirmation that rates were verified against the official authority publication on the stated date, and that supply dates after any rate change are treated accordingly.
notes: Verify with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority publications; record the verification date.

name: Input tax recoverability
description: Whether input tax on costs is recoverable. Recoverable tax is excluded from cost; irrecoverable input tax is part of cost.
notes: Depends on client and entity status.

name: Pre-tax cost definition
description: Cost basis before tax used for margin and markup calculation.
notes: Do not apply markup to recoverable tax.

name: Output tax treatment
description: How output tax is computed and shown on the sell price.

name: Final payable amount
description: Definition of the final payable amount (sell price plus output tax, less retention and withholding where applicable).

name: Withholding tax on foreign payments
description: Whether withholding tax applies to payments to non-resident subcontractors/suppliers and who bears it.
notes: Verify current rules and treaties.

name: Zakat and corporate income tax
description: Treatment of zakat or corporate income tax in pricing (normally not included in cost estimate).
notes: Not included unless company policy states otherwise.

name: Customs duties versus VAT on imports
description: Separation of customs duties from import tax on imports in the cost build-up.
notes: Link to F.

name: Tax on employee-related costs
description: Any tax or levies on expatriate labour (e.g. expatriate levy) included in labour on-cost.
notes: Verify current levies and rates.

name: Tax treatment of free-issue items
description: Tax treatment of client-supplied materials.

name: Tax treatment of subcontractor invoices
description: Tax status of subcontractor quotes (inclusive/exclusive) and reverse charge, if any.

name: Tax invoicing and timing assumption
description: Date of supply or invoice used for determining the applicable rate.

name: Tax exemption or special status
description: Special exemptions or zero-rating (e.g. government, free zone, qualifying projects).
notes: Evidence required.

name: Tax rounding rule
description: Rounding rules for tax amounts on invoices.

name: Inspection and test plan
description: Requirements for inspection and test plans, hold points and witness points.

name: Third-party testing and inspection
description: Third-party laboratories and inspection bodies (materials testing, NDT, welding, structural inspection) and who pays.
notes: Fees from quotes.

name: Authority witnessing and approvals
description: Civil Defense, municipality and utility authority inspections and approvals, including fees and lead times.

name: Material testing frequency
description: Frequency of sampling and testing (concrete cubes, soil compaction, steel).
notes: Frequencies defined in specification.

name: Pressure and leak testing - piping
description: Hydrostatic and leak testing of plumbing, fire and chilled-water systems; water, labour and disposal.

name: HVAC testing, adjusting and balancing
description: TAB and commissioning of air and water systems, independent agency requirements.

name: Electrical testing and commissioning
description: Testing of cables, switchgear, protection, earthing and lighting; independent testing and utility witnessing.

name: Fire and life-safety integrated testing
description: Integrated testing of fire alarm, suppression, smoke control and cause-and-effect.

name: ELV testing and commissioning
description: Testing of ELV systems, network certification and acceptance.

name: Systems commissioning and performance verification
description: Commissioning scope, seasonal commissioning and performance verification periods.
notes: Seasonal commissioning may extend the period.

name: Commissioning authority or specialist
description: Independent commissioning agent and who pays.

name: Operation and maintenance manuals
description: O&M manuals, as-built drawings, warranty documents, number of copies and formats.

name: As-built drawings and BIM handover
description: As-built and digital handover requirements.

name: Training of client operators
description: Operator training scope, hours and trainers.

name: Spare parts and special tools
description: Commissioning spares, two-year spares and special tools.

name: Warranty and handover obligations
description: Warranty certificates, handover process, snagging and defects rectification.

name: Testing cost responsibility
description: Who pays for retesting after failure.

name: Snagging and punch-list allowance
description: Allowance for snagging and defects rectification before handover.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Statutory certificates for occupancy
description: Certificates required (e.g. completion, occupancy, Civil Defense).
notes: Include fees and lead time.

name: Testing water, power and consumables
description: Utilities consumed during testing and commissioning.

name: Post-handover maintenance obligations
description: Free maintenance period or post-completion service obligations.

name: Rate source confidence rule
description: Confidence assigned to rates by source type (quote, historical project, benchmark, estimator allowance).
notes: Mapping approved by Estimator.

name: Rate age warning threshold
description: Rate age in days beyond which a low-confidence warning is raised on the rate.
notes: Methodological threshold subject to approval; must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Rate age maximum
description: Maximum age in days beyond which a rate is not allowed to be used without explicit override.
notes: No default; company policy decision.

name: Design maturity assessment
description: Assessment of design maturity per division, from concept to approved-for-construction.

name: Quantity completeness assessment
description: Percentage or rating of how complete quantities are.

name: Supplier quote coverage
description: Share of cost covered by current supplier or subcontractor quotations.
notes: Calculated, not defaulted.

name: Subcontractor quote coverage
description: Share of subcontracted scope with competitive quotations received.

name: Number of quotes per package
description: Minimum quotes needed for confidence on major packages.
notes: Company policy.

name: Unresolved assumptions count
description: Number of open assumptions not yet approved.
notes: Estimates with open mandatory assumptions should not be issued as final.

name: Unresolved mandatory assumptions blocking issue
description: Rule that blocks issue of estimate while mandatory assumptions remain undecided.

name: Commercial exposure rating
description: Qualitative or quantitative rating of commercial exposure (contract risk, uncapped liabilities).

name: Rates not verified for date or region
description: Count/list of rates with unknown date or region.

name: Benchmark deviation threshold
description: Deviation from benchmark ranges that triggers review of an estimate.
notes: Must be approved by Estimator before use.

name: Overall estimate confidence
description: Overall confidence classification and its derivation.

name: Risk register reference
description: Reference to the project risk register informing risk allowances.

name: Confidence of defaults and unverified data
description: Rule that default values remain Low confidence until human approval.

name: Single-source dependency
description: Dependence on a single supplier or subcontractor for key items.

name: Market volatility exposure
description: Items with high market volatility (steel, copper, fuel) and handling.

name: Estimator review and approval status
description: Sign-off status of the estimate and reviewer.

name: Data source licensing and usage restrictions
description: Restrictions on reuse of third-party data.
